scope: Diagnostic reproduction and fixes; not acceptance of a mixed or dirty build. Consistent candidate 31017 qualification remains required.

guest.host: Disposable Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 Lima VZ guest

baseline.basic_su: passed from UID 2000 to UID 0 with an explicit lab grant
baseline.api5_probe: failed: module result null; daemon access denied

fixes.problem: Hidden securityfs plus nonempty AppArmor context prevented detection of disabled SELinux, rejecting legitimate pre-specialization zygote clients.
fixes.change: Require matching named AppArmor context and a well-formed kernel filesystem list containing proc but no selinuxfs. Missing, contradictory and I/O-error evidence fails closed. Existing root UID, executable, process-name and ancestry checks remain unchanged.
fixes.host_regression: Observed Waydroid-shaped fixture fails before the change and passes afterward; active SELinux and identity rejection tests remain passing.

fixes.problem: fd_get_attr performed fgetxattr(security.selinux) on the companion socket; EOPNOTSUPP caused an early return without invoking the module or closing the client. Modules could block system-server startup.
fixes.change: Use fstat device/inode identity without security-label queries. Close the still-owned descriptor on initial metadata failure; preserve the existing protection against closing a descriptor reused by the callback.
fixes.host_regression: Actual dispatcher tested with real sockets for delivery, close, replacement descriptors, metadata failure and invalid descriptors.

diagnostics.limit: Bundled fixture acceptance is distinct from the separately tested Shamiko 1.2.5 signing-identity rejection.

fixture_limits: Private boot hook starts the exact native payload before zygote; magiskinit/OEM boot-image paths are not tested by this route.
The bootstrap payload is separate from the mutable app-managed databin.
The Android window must remain active in headless Weston; Waydroid otherwise freezes the container.
No physical OEM or hardware-attestation claim.
